title: Implement Multi-Tenant Google Workspace Customer License Extraction
user_story: As a system administrator, I need to automate the extraction of Google Workspace Customer Licenses from the Cloud Channel API for all managed tenants so that we can report on license utilization within the Inscape platform. This requires a multi-tenant aware extraction job that can securely access a central OAuth credential to authenticate against the Google Cloud Channel API.
acceptance_criteria: The Cloud Run job is deployed and configured via Terraform.
The Tenant Service Account has access to the central OAuth secret.
The channelServicesData_Daily.py script successfully extracts license data from the Cloud Channel API.
The Dockerfile is updated to use Python 3.11 and includes the extraction script.
The BigQuery loader function is updated to handle the customer_licenses path and nested data structures.
The extracted license data is successfully loaded into BigQuery.
The end-to-end process is validated with correct Customer ID and successful data ingestion.

tasks.title: Infrastructure - Define Multi-Tenant Cloud Run Job in Terraform
tasks.description: Update locals.tf within the mas-gw-inscape-onboarding module to include the customer-licenses job blueprint. Configure environment variables GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT and CONFIG_BUCKET. Set the command override to ["python", "channelServicesData_Daily.py"].

tasks.title: Security - Implement Cross-Project IAM Bridge for Central Secret
tasks.description: Add a google_secret_manager_secret_iam_member resource in iam.tf. Grant the Tenant Service Account (module.service_account_gw_sa.service_account_email) the roles/secretmanager.secretAccessor role on the central management project (1034826682693). Target: Secret ID channel-services-oauth.

tasks.title: Application - Develop Channel Services Extraction Script
tasks.description: Implement channelServicesData_Daily.py with logic to fetch OAuth2 credentials from the Central Secret Manager. Retrieve config.json from the tenant's -config bucket. Establish an AuthorizedSession using the central refresh_token. Query cloudchannel.googleapis.com/v1/accounts/C024pmm3z/customers/{customer_id}/entitlements. Save results as a partitioned Parquet file to the -reporting bucket.

tasks.title: Containerization - Update ETL Dockerfile & Environment
tasks.description: Modify the Dockerfile to use python:3.11-slim. Ensure COPY channelServicesData_Daily.py . is included in the build steps. Re-build and push the image to the Artifact Registry.

tasks.title: Data Engineering - Update BigQuery Loader Cloud Function
tasks.description: Update loadToBigQuery.py to recognize the customer_licenses path. Implement a WRITE_TRUNCATE strategy for the customer_licenses table. Enable parquet_options.enable_list_inference = True.

tasks.title: Integration - Final End-to-End Validation
tasks.description: Verify the config.json contains the correct Channel Services Customer ID. Execute the Cloud Run Job and confirm the 404 error is replaced by a successful GCS upload and BigQuery ingestion.
